job: Show an organisation's first letter as a dot-matrix mark where it has no logo.
purpose: A drawn mark: the first letter of a name on a 5 by 7 grid of dots, lit dots in the box's colour and unlit ones faint. The same name always draws the same glyph and takes the same tone. It goes in a brand mark, tile or avatar through data-fd-initial, or as an SVG string from initial.js on a server or in an email.
useWhen: An organisation, team or brand has no uploaded logo and needs a mark in the brand slot, a tile or an avatar.
An email or a server-rendered page needs the same mark: call initialMark() or initialRows(), no DOM needed.
A list of organisations should be told apart at a glance without anyone choosing a colour.

avoidWhen.when: A person's initials, or a box smaller than 28px.
The thing has a real logo or a symbol: an icon, an image.
The product's own mark, or a logotype in the current colour.

states.name: no script
states.how: the host keeps its own letter, styled by the tile or avatar

states.name: other character
states.how: a first character that is not A to Z or 0 to 9 draws a diamond

parts.role: The drawing: an svg in currentColor, sized by its box.
